intro.text: General Drakes, who stands in the king's throne room at Kingseat and strikes December as a man much like Bark.
Mountaincrest's Minister of Defense, a general in charge of the army at Kingseat and, to an extent, across the kingdom.
Mountaincrest's Minister of Defense and the king's most outspoken critic, a stern general killed after being tied to December's supposed plot.

items.text: Drakes broke up a meeting at the Concordance teahouse and arrested Count Flint, who had been talking with December.

Soon after, he brought December to his office to ask about her public defence of Flint. He admitted he had once believed in Flint too, suspected the arrest was a setup, and rushed off when he heard Geoffrim and Petva were involved.
Geoffrim tied him to December's supposed plot against the king, and Drakes was killed.

appearance.text: A huge, broad-chested man with light tan skin and a heavy brow that gives him an angry look, though he is mostly squinting from poor sight. He wears the palace guard's layered black and red, with a white cape and many medals.

personality.text: Known for sternness with his troops and open criticism of the king, he is kinder and sharper than his scowl suggests, and thinks Flint a decent man at heart.
